shapeSummary: Wheel with its axis along Z, 96 mm OD and 32 mm wide. The center is at Y=48, so the bottom sits at Y=0. It is a 96 mm OD ring with a 76 mm ID (10 mm wall) running the full width. An 8 mm thick hub plate spans z=-8 to 0, leaving an 8 mm recess on one side and a 16 mm recess on the other. The plate has a 32 mm central bore and 30 round 4 mm holes on an 8 mm grid.
warnings: The four slotted holes near (0,±24) and (±24,0) are omitted because their slot length is not dimensioned.
The rubber tread and the plastic rim are modeled as one solid. The tread-to-rim boundary is not separated.
The 4 mm hole positions were read from the drawing's 8mm grid and may be slightly off.
The source dimensions are marked unverified.
